findings.summary: Run-evidence note says the pre-existing suite was 111 `it(` declarations while spec F17 states 114 cases. Both are correct and no test was deleted: the repo has 111 static `it(` declarations outside test/export.test.ts, and test/ingest.test.ts declares one `it(` inside a 4-iteration for-loop over [epub, mobi, chm, azw], so vitest reports 24 tests for that file and 114 overall — matching the N1 acceptance record. Wording only; no product defect.

The terminal marker is carried out by re-rendering the parsed marker through S4's own renderReportBody, not by slicing the literal substring. This is field-complete and byte-identical for markers S4 emitted, and the untouched report body is appended immediately below (so the literal marker text is present regardless), but a body with non-canonical whitespace inside the comment would be normalized on export. No field is dropped or reinterpreted, so §3 and F6 are satisfied.
